title: Library with 12 products
summary: Priya's Library at twelve products: the display h1, the calmer attention shelf (one card, two items, only the most urgent with a solid action), a toolbar with search (⌘K), counted chips, sort and Grid/List, and the dense grid (PX-35): 5:2 art or the flat tint, the 40 px icon, the name, the tier and any issue pill, one outlined quick action and More; four up at 1440, so eight tiles show in two rows. The page ends in the sticky 'Missing a license?' strip, led by Activate a license (no key tile at eight and more).
compare: 2026-10-20 redraw (PX-35, BR-lockups, P0-36), to the owner-approved build ('tighten them up a bit to allow for more to show up'; 'the missing a license section should be a sticky footer'): the header's Activate license button is gone (the account menu's first item, 'Activate a license'); the phone bar is Library · Discover, docked full width; the 'Polaris Locker · Help · Privacy' footer is gone (Help and Privacy are in the account menu); the header brand is the trimmed outlined Locker lockup at the guide's size (BR-lockups: 40 px tall in the 64 px header, 36 px under 761 px, the mark alone under 384 px); the grid is the dense one (5:2 art, 40 px icon, 12 px padding; 2/3/4/5 columns at 0/761/1180/1700 px, 12 apart, 16 from 761 px); 'Missing a license?' is the sticky strip, here led by 'Activate a license'; Diceroll's tile shows its warning device pill; the shelf's date is US 'Oct 31, 2026' (P0-36).
The attention shelf is one card; only its most urgent item (Diceroll on 3 of 3 devices) has a solid action, the rest are outlined (B12, portal-17). A full license reads neutral (DL6).
Toolbar: search with ⌘K, counted chips (All 12 selected, Updates, Games, Apps), sort, Grid/List as a segmented switch.

Dense tiles (kit .portal-grid.dense): the art in a 5:2 band (the product's art, or its stored flat tint with the icon large and centred, never a gradient), the 40 px icon 16 over its lower edge, the name once (16/22, two lines at most), the tier pill and an issue pill when there is one ('3/3 devices' in warning), one outlined quick action and More. Four up at 1440 (eight tiles in two rows), five at 1700 px and up, three from 761 px, two on a phone.

Under 208 px of tile (a phone's two columns) the icon stacks above the name with More level with it, the pills take a line each, and the action spans the tile without its icon. A tile with no art keeps its name first under the tint, More beside it.
No product name painted over art; a status pill sits on the art's top-right corner, 8 px in (PX-35).

'Missing a license?' is the Library's sticky strip (as portal.library), resting at the page's end in a full-page shot: one line from 1180 px, 'Activate a license' first because no key tile shows at eight products and more; a closed disclosure below 1180 px, on the bottom bar on a phone.
Round 2 (UX review): A product without hosted art shows its icon large and centred on its stored tint, its name starting the body; never a wall of empty colour (M9).
